results.title: Hemmed: Hide Mac menu bar clutter and pin individual actions | Product Hunt
results.content:
Hungry Icons: on battery power, when hidden or tray-rescued menu bar apps use high energy, Hemmed shows a silent compact leaf-and-count pill (🍃 N) beside the glyph, badges those icons in the tray, and offers a one-click "Quit the hungry ones" action

   Same Bar on Every Mac: Hemmed syncs your menu bar layout across your Macs through iCloud automatically, including hidden/visible state, icon order, Pinned Actions, and preferences (requires being signed into iCloud)

Hemmed is a native Swift app for macOS 13 or later. It is $14.99 paid once (up to 3 Macs per license), with a 14-day free trial and a 30-day refund window.

Would love your feedback and questions! I'll be here in the comments.
